'''Gorsick Dommaro''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] that was stationed on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] as part of the [[Security Sector]]. The [[A68 Market]], one of the most active [[Black market/Legends|black markets]] on the entire station, was under Dommaro's direct control.
